title: Fund deductions
html:
Fund deductions

104. The duty of noting the proper deductions to be made from pay bills on account of funds devolves on the drawers of the bills, but no discretion is allowed in carrying out an order received from the Accountant General or a fund examiner to make any particular deduction.

104-A. The Treasury Officer must, however, check the deductions in the case of the Indian Civil Service Family Pension Regulations and the Superior Services (India) Family Pension Fund Rules.

NOTE—See also paragraph 385 regarding the attaching of a schedule to each bill in which a fund deduction is included.
